name: magi
reference: Liu, Yang, et al. Revisiting Modularity Maximization for Graph Clustering: A Contrastive Learning Perspective (MAGI). KDD 2024.

upstream.note: Clone + separate driver, no patch: the Encoder/Model (magi/model.py) and the sampling/helpers in magi/utils.py are imported unchanged and the authors' files are left pristine. run_magi.py runs the full-graph GCN variant (train_gcn.py) with a KMeans readout over the learned embedding.
upstream.variant: Full-graph GCN only. The contrastive loss is a dense N x N similarity, so it is O(n^2) and will MLE on large graphs; MAGI's scalable minibatch SAGE variant (train_sage.py) is a separate entry point, not migrated here.

hidden.doc: GNN encoder widths (comma-separated for multiple layers). Settable per graph class but excluded from tuning.

feature_kind.doc: Synthetic node representation used only when the instance has no real features.

learning_rate.doc: Adam learning rate. Set per dataset in the paper (5e-4 for most GCN datasets, 1e-4 CiteSeer; Table 5) but never swept, so set-only.

tau.doc: Contrastive loss temperature. Paper sweeps it (Fig 5, optimum ~0.5); tunable.

wt.doc: Number of random walks. Paper sweeps #walks in Fig 4 (1-100); tunable.

wl.doc: Random-walk depth. A headline sensitivity knob (Fig 4, l in {1,3,5,10}, optimum ~5); tunable.
